Moclobemide Potentiation
I have enjoyed many wonderful experiences using a combination of moclobemide and marijuana.
I find that it is best to take the moclobemide at least one hour prior to smoking the weed but if the moclobemide is taken several hours in advance or even up to 6-8 hours prior to smoking the weed the experience is still potentiated.
100 150mgs of moclobemide works effectively for me. I usually take 100mgs (one pill) one or two hours prior to smoking and then 50mgs (half a pill) when I smoke.
The effect is quite different than weed by itself. In one sense the high is reduced and in another it is greatly magnified and changed.
I definitely get less fucked up  I experience less disorientation and much less frontal lobotomy  frontal lobotomy is my term for the marijuana effect that debilitates my higher thought processes and reasoning. The kind of effect that makes me wonder if I am in a good state of mind to interact with sober people.
On straight weed I get a little paranoid because I correctly analyze that in many ways Im not as good as normal. I entertain thoughts like if x y z person turned up right now Im sure I would look and sound stoned and therefore I am ashamed that I am recreationally giving my self a frontal lobotomy.'
Not so with my wonderful discovery of moclobemide  The high lasts longer and my higher reasoning is intact and even enhanced so I dont feel paranoid because I feel confident to handle whatever situations arise. The high becomes more trip-like although it's not a visual trip, it becomes spiritual trip.
The high becomes more trip-like although it's not a visual trip, it becomes spiritual trip.
I experience wonderful revelations. I have incredible adventures and my vibe is contagious. Because I have no problem socializing with sober people I hang out a lot more. My ego is somewhat dissolved and I flow with nature and random events naturally.
I first learned about moclobemide from [ ] and I thought it would be a good potentiator of mushrooms (Ive been doing Mocolo for about 18 months now and I still havent combined it with mushrooms as my Syrian rue is doing a great job).
Two nights ago I smoked weed straight  Never again, Im on to a good thing!
